boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named destinations along the Monte Vista, Crowell, and Countryside corridors immediately around Stanislaus State.

cards.title: The Vista
cards.subtitle: West Monte Vista Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use West Monte Vista Avenue to identify this student-housing destination; the City record documents its approved 720-bed configuration.
cards.short_summary: A named student-housing landmark beside the campus approach.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Turlock approved an amendment for The Vista at 900 W. Monte Vista Avenue that brought its total to 720 beds in 180 units.
cards.source_title: City of Turlock — Archived Residential Projects (2018)
cards.access_notes: Private residential property; view from public streets only.

cards.title: Warrior Crossings
cards.subtitle: West Monte Vista Avenue corridor at Crowell Road
cards.notes: Find the named retail center at the Monte Vista/Crowell access point and use it as a clear landmark when orienting off campus.
cards.short_summary: A named retail-center landmark at the campus-side commercial junction.
cards.evidence_claim: A City planning document identifies Warrior Crossings at 1201 W. Monte Vista Avenue, with access from Crowell Road and Monte Vista Avenue.
cards.source_title: City of Turlock — Warrior Crossings proposed mitigated negative declaration
cards.access_notes: Individual tenants set their own access and purchase requirements.

cards.title: Kabob Place
cards.subtitle: Crowell Road corridor
cards.notes: Look for the named restaurant at 3821 Crowell Road; confirm service details with the business before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A recently announced restaurant address on Crowell Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The Turlock Chamber of Commerce lists Kabob Place at 3821 Crowell Road and announced its March 31, 2026 soft-opening ribbon cutting.
cards.source_title: Turlock Chamber of Commerce — Ribbon Cutting: Kabob Place
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are optional; verify current hours directly.

cards.title: Cosmos Burgers
cards.subtitle: Crowell Road corridor opposite Stanislaus State
cards.notes: Use the 3831 Crowell Road address to locate this independently named restaurant across from the university.
cards.short_summary: A named Crowell Road restaurant directly opposite campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Turlock Journal reports that Cosmos Burgers is at 3831 Crowell Road across the street from Stanislaus State.
cards.source_title: Turlock Journal — Former prison-themed restaurant now serves cosmic menu
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; verify current hours directly.

cards.title: Jessica's House
cards.subtitle: Crowell Road corridor
cards.notes: Note this named nonprofit on Crowell Road; contact Jessica’s House first if seeking its free peer-support groups.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit destination providing grief-support programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Jessica's House states that it provides free peer-support groups for children, teens, young adults, and families; its permanent home opened on Cornerstone Covenant Church property in 2021.
cards.source_title: Jessica's House — Mission, Vision, Values and History
cards.access_notes: Groups and services require contacting the organization; its support groups are described as free.

cards.title: Monte Vista Chapel
cards.subtitle: East Monte Vista Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the chapel’s 1619 E. Monte Vista Avenue address as a named landmark on the eastbound Monte Vista corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named community institution on the eastern Monte Vista approach.
cards.evidence_claim: Monte Vista Chapel lists its address as 1619 E. Monte Vista Avenue in Turlock.
cards.access_notes: Public event availability varies; check the chapel directly.

cards.title: Calvary Baptist Church
cards.subtitle: East Monte Vista Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use 700 E. Monte Vista Avenue as the reference point for this named church along the eastbound campus approach.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing named church on the Monte Vista corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvary Baptist Church’s Church Center page describes the congregation as part of the Turlock community for over 100 years and lists two Sunday services.
cards.source_title: Calvary Baptist Church — Welcome to Calvary
cards.access_notes: Worship and program access varies by schedule; check the church directly.

cards.title: Ten Pin Fun Center
cards.subtitle: Countryside Drive corridor
cards.notes: Head to 3700 Countryside Drive for bowling, arcade games, laser tag, and party spaces; activity pricing applies.
cards.short_summary: A family-entertainment destination off the west Monte Vista retail corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Ten Pin Fun Center lists 34 bowling lanes, arcade/redemption games, laser tag, party spaces, and its 3700 Countryside Drive Turlock address.
cards.access_notes: Activities require payment; venue lists current operating hours on its site.

cards.title: Monte Vista Crossings
cards.subtitle: Countryside Drive corridor near West Monte Vista Avenue
cards.notes: Use this named shopping-center destination to orient along Countryside Drive; select an individual tenant before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named retail center linking the Countryside and Monte Vista commercial area.
cards.evidence_claim: A City of Turlock planning record identifies Monte Vista Crossings LLC at 2701 Countryside Drive and describes a multi-tenant freeway sign for the center.
cards.source_title: City of Turlock — Commercial & Industrial Projects (2013)
cards.access_notes: Each retailer controls its own hours, access, and costs.

cards.title: Target Turlock
cards.subtitle: Countryside Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the 3000 Countryside Drive store as a named errand stop; Target lists Drive Up pickup for orders placed in its app.
cards.short_summary: A named general-merchandise store on the Countryside retail corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Target’s official store page identifies Target Turlock at 3000 Countryside Drive and lists Drive Up as an available service.
cards.access_notes: Store entry is free; merchandise and pickup orders require purchase.
